Jordan / Grace — adding a quick technical note from the serving/runtime perspective:

- Burst capacity approach: recommend a two-tier pool model — reserved baseline + burst pool attached to your region. Burst pool can be provisioned as hot spare capacity with pre-warmed kernels for typical VeritaCorp workloads.
- Quantized fallback: we can publish a latency delta matrix for your key prompts. Typical p50/p95 for the quantized variant is ~10–30% slower depending on prompt length; cost savings are 40–55%.
- Autoscaling: suggest rule-based scaling with a 200ms sustained window to avoid thrash during campaign ramps.

If you can send 1–2 sample prompts and typical sequence lengths, we can run a short profiling job during Aug 16–20 and include numbers in the cost appendix.

I'll be on the kickoff; happy to handle the profiling coordination.
